kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نخضوضر (form XII)
# نَخْضَوْضِرُ (naḵḍawḍiru) /nax.dˤaw.dˤi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# نَخْضَوْضِرَ (naḵḍawḍira) /nax.dˤaw.dˤi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
# نَخْضَوْضِرْ (naḵḍawḍir) /nax.dˤaw.dˤir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْضَوْضَرَ (iḵḍawḍara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
